summary: UI navigation-advance handler: dispatches a virtual call through vtable entry 11 (offset 0x2C on obj) with argument 1, increments a counter at this+0x14C, then calls sub_489D00 and FloatToIntConversion. Linear, always returns 0. Called by UIScrollbarThumbDragHandler and UIScrollListUpdate.

local_names.this: UI handler object whose vtable carries the entry-11 advance callback and whose +0x14C field holds a counter

operations.description: Virtual dispatch through vtable entry 11 (offset 0x2C on obj) with argument 1; entry is read from the vtable pointer at this+0x0
Increments the counter at this+0x14C (source index this[83])
